description: This file defines the InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand class, which is a console command for installing and configuring OrangeHRM on a new database. It handles user input, database setup, system checks, and orchestrates the installation process with multiple steps.

classes.name: InstallOnNewDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A console command class responsible for orchestrating the installation of OrangeHRM on a new database. Includes steps for license acceptance, database configuration, system checks, instance creation, admin user setup, and final installation procedures.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution entry point for the command, checks for mode and prior installation, then executes the install process.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Orchestrates the sequence of steps for installing OrangeHRM, called internally by execute.

methods.name: getAppSetupUtility
methods.description: Creates or returns the singleton instance of AppSetupUtility, used for database and migration operations.

methods.name: licenseAcceptance
methods.description: Prompts the user to accept the license agreement.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Collects database configuration details from user input and validates existing database and user permissions.

methods.name: systemCheck
methods.description: Performs system environment checks and prompts user to accept risks if checks fail.

methods.name: instanceCreation
methods.description: Gathers organization details, country, language, timezone info from user to configure the OrangeHRM instance.

methods.name: adminUserCreation
methods.description: Creates the initial admin user with name, email, contact, and password, and registers the system if consented.

methods.name: installation
methods.description: Runs the detailed installation process including database creation, permission checks, migrations, configuration, and final setup steps.
